# Regal Hardwood Floors LLC

> Third-generation hardwood flooring specialists serving Portland Metro and SW Washington since 1998. Expert in hardwood installation, refinishing, and seamless floor blending — including lace-in repair and old-to-new blending that most contractors won't attempt.

## About

Jade Barnes and Justin Barnes are a father-and-son team representing the third generation of their family's flooring trade. Founded in 1998, Regal Hardwood Floors LLC is owner-operated — no subcontractors. CCB #113140.

**Phone:** 971-431-8823  
**Service Area:** Lake Oswego, West Linn, Dunthorpe, SW Portland, West Hills, Camas WA  
**Specialty:** Hardwood floor blending and lace-in repair for historic and high-end Portland homes

## Services

- **Hardwood Floor Blending** — Seamless lace-in repair integrating new boards with existing floors. Priced per project after free on-site assessment. Starting at $1,800.
- **Hardwood Floor Refinishing** — Sanding, staining, and resealing. Labor $3.40–$4.60/sqft. Typical 1,000 sqft project costs $3,400–$4,600.
- **Hardwood Floor Installation** — Site-finished solid and engineered hardwood. Every board hand-set.
- **LVP Installation** — Premium luxury vinyl plank for high-moisture areas and basements.

## Key Facts

- In business since 1998 (27+ years)
- Father and son team — 3rd generation flooring craftsmen
- No subcontractors on any project
- Specialty: blending old and new hardwood invisibly — rare skill most contractors decline
- Free in-home estimates for all projects
- Oregon Licensed Contractor CCB #113140
